_note: Hand-scored by us against planted-bugs.md (sealed before the run), strict: found = a reported finding (any severity, including Low) whose root cause AND fix cover the planted bug. A partial match counts as missed. A mention only in Architecture Observations, or as dead code in a different finding's fix, does not count. Scoring is our judgment; the reasons are listed per bug so anyone can re-score.
